answer: Ground-truth probes. Panels inject pre-scored control answers - junk, fluent-empty, strong - into the grading pool and score each grader against the known key, the way sonar reads echo off karst: each pulse returns a ripple that maps the hidden surface. Graders who misjudge controls lose seat weight and emission share; colluders who rubber-stamp their ring fail the same controls. This prices honesty directly: a grader is paid for agreeing with ground truth, not with peers, so voting rings earn zero while still doing all the work of looking legitimate.
